select padu.financing_code as financingCode ,cbi.id as contractId ,cbi.contract_code as contractCode , cbi.client_id as clientId ,c.client_name as clientName ,cbi.proj_code as projCode ,cbi.proj_name as projName , cbi.biz_type as bizType ,cbi.apply_credit_amount as contractAmount, pad.our_account_name as accountName , pad.our_account_number as accountNumber ,pad.our_account_bank as accountBank ,pad.paid_in_amount as putoutAmount , pad.paid_in_date as putoutDate from payment_actual_detail_unconfirmed padu inner join payment_base_info pbi on padu.payment_id = pbi.id inner join payment_actual_detail pad on padu.id = pad.un_confirmed_id left join contract_base_info cbi on pbi.contract_id = cbi.id left join client c on cbi.client_id = c.id
padu.financing_code is not null and pbi.write_off_status = 'WRITTEN_OFF' and padu.capital_source = 'BANK_LOAN' and pad.write_off_status = 'WRITTEN_OFF' and padu.financing_code = #{financingCode}

select fdfbi.id as directId, ffbi.id as finanId ,padu.financing_code as financingCode ,cbi.id as contractId ,cbi.contract_code as contractCode , cbi.client_id as clientId ,c.client_name as clientName ,cbi.proj_code as projCode ,cbi.proj_name as projName , cbi.biz_type as bizType ,cbi.apply_credit_amount as contractAmount, pad.our_account_name as accountName , pad.our_account_number as accountNumber ,pad.our_account_bank as accountBank ,pad.paid_in_amount as putoutAmount , pad.paid_in_date as putoutDate from payment_actual_detail_unconfirmed padu inner join payment_base_info pbi on padu.payment_id = pbi.id inner join payment_actual_detail pad on padu.id = pad.un_confirmed_id left join contract_base_info cbi on pbi.contract_id = cbi.id left join client c on cbi.client_id = c.id left join fund_direct_financing_base_info fdfbi on padu.financing_code = fdfbi.financing_code left join fund_financing_base_info ffbi on padu.financing_code = ffbi.financing_code
padu.financing_code is not null and pbi.write_off_status = 'WRITTEN_OFF' and pad.write_off_status = 'WRITTEN_OFF' and padu.capital_source = 'BANK_LOAN'
and padu.financing_code like CONCAT('%',#{query.financingCode},'%')
and cbi.contract_code like CONCAT('%',#{query.contractCode},'%')
